loops.minute_1: Manual click on giant cookie (1 cookie per click). Immediate feedback loop: click → +1 cookie → visual counter increment.
loops.minute_10: Purchase first buildings (Cursor 5c, Grandma 10c). Transition to passive income; buildings auto-generate cookies/sec. Initial synergies unlock (Cursor × Grandma = upgrade bonuses).
loops.hour_5: Accumulate towards ~1M all-time cookies baked. Golden Cookie hunting (random spawns, temporary 7× production multiplier). Unlock mid-game buildings (Farm, Mine, Factory). Upgrade purchasing creates exponential cost jumps; players experience 'prestige threshold awareness'.
loops.endgame: Prestige reset cycles: accumulate Heavenly Chips (cube root of all-time cookies baked), spend on permanent Heavenly Upgrades (+1% CPS each). Each cycle shortens grind time to next reset. Late-game unlock: Dragon bonuses (massive multipliers), Grimoire (spell-casting minigame), Pantheon (passive blessing system). Infinite progression with no win state.

objectives.player_goal: Optimize ascension cycles to maximize Heavenly Chips gained; unlock Dragon bonuses and end-game systems (Grimoire, Pantheon) to achieve maximum prestige and CPS production.

games.retention_answer: Prestige resets create exponential acceleration: each cycle feels 5-10× faster than the last, triggering reward dopamine spikes. Variable schedule reinforcement alternates cheap-upgrade 'slots' with long-save patience tests. Minigame discovery (Grandmapocalypse, Wrinklers, Wrath Cookies) creates surprise checkpoints. Golden Cookies spawn unpredictably, rewarding active play. No failure state means zero frustration; only upward numbers.

loops.minute_1: Drag-and-drop food and toys into yard. Minimal interaction; app remains active for ~30 seconds. Interface clarity and tactile feedback establish minimal friction. Aesthetic appeal of items shown in yard creates immediate attachment.
loops.minute_10: Close app. Cats visit asynchronously while app is closed. Return to app after 5-30 mins → find cats present, collect fish rewards (silver + gold). Visual discovery of cat variety (different animations, sizes, colors) triggers collectathon psychology.
loops.hour_5: Experiment with item combos to attract rares. Gold fish earned → purchase new toys/furniture → unlock rare cat unlock conditions. Yard expansion purchase (180+ gold fish) doubles available spaces. Catbook photo album grows; each new cat photo is a micro-achievement.
loops.endgame: Collectathon loop: systematically unlock all 86+ cat variants by matching preference patterns. Hidden unlock conditions (e.g., 'Tabby cat only appears if Deluxe Box + Sushi present') discovered via wiki or trial-and-error. No true 'end'; game continues indefinitely (v2 adds durability mechanics, new cats, new challenges). Progression becomes 100% completion hunt.

objectives.victory_condition: Collect all 86+ cats (including rare variants) and achieve Catbook completion
objectives.player_goal: Discover each cat's preferred food/toy combination and assemble a complete yard collection, expanding yard as needed and documenting all cats in the Catbook photo album.

games.retention_answer: Collection psychology ('gotta catch 'em all') is primal; each new cat is a dopamine spike. Visual appeal (cute cat designs, variety) creates intrinsic motivation. Time-gating (cats only appear offline) rewards periodic returns. Preference puzzle (discovering hidden unlock conditions) engages curiosity over hours. No failure state eliminates frustration. Offline progression = reward for patience; opening app becomes a 'treasure check' ritual.
